summary: Milvus unauthenticated denial of service via /management/stop
description: Milvus through 2.6.22 and 3.0.0 contains an unauthenticated denial of service vulnerability that allows remote attackers to terminate service components by sending a crafted HTTP GET request to the management server on port 9091. Attackers can exploit the unprotected /management/stop endpoint, which bypasses REST API authentication middleware, by supplying a 'role' parameter to shut down the proxy, datanode, or querynode components, resulting in denial of service. NOTE: vecmap treats this endpoint as advisory-only and never invokes it during scans.

summary: Chroma authorization bypass via collection identifier
description: Chroma through 1.5.9 fails to validate tenant and database segments when resolving collections, allowing authenticated attackers to access collections from other tenants by knowing the collection identifier. Attackers can read, modify, and update records in foreign collections by issuing requests under their own tenant path, bypassing authorization checks.

summary: Typesense unauthenticated denial of service in /multi_search
description: Prior to versions 29.1 and 30.2, there is an unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability in the /multi_search endpoint. A specially crafted request can trigger an unhandled exception during request processing, causing the server process to terminate. Patched in 29.1 and 30.2.

summary: Typesense search cache isolation flaw with scoped API keys
description: Prior to versions 29.1 and 30.2, there is a cache isolation issue affecting search requests that use both server-side search result caching and Scoped Search API Keys. Under specific request ordering, cached search results could be reused across requests with different Scoped Search API Key constraints. Patched in 29.1 and 30.2.
